source.title: Diverse cancers converge on one region of normal cell-state space in a cancer-blind coordinate system
source.author: Spiro, Theodor
source.manuscript: Paper 3, v11 (main text and Supporting Information)
source.note: Every number below is transcribed from the manuscript; where a value is derived or a membership is not fully determined by the printed tables, the entry says so.

definitions.quarantine_note: Post-cellular bodies and the documented low-complexity artifact (Notes S3, S-K). They are removed from the candidate pool before the nearest-neighbour step and their cells are reassigned to the best surviving neighbour, leaving 152 candidates.
definitions.secondary_status: Carried no further than a secondary target: its assignment falls with detected-gene count exactly as the quarantined erythrocyte does (Fig. 3D, Fig. S7). It is not set aside for being blood-specific.

region_names.core: two-cell core: cytotrophoblast + megakaryocyte (main text, within-patient test)
region_names.three_cell_core: core + migrating cytotrophoblast (referee-control notes, ~2% chance baseline)

region_rule.note: Boundaries are ranks in the cross-cancer recurrence ranking (Table S2). The core and the four-cell neighbourhood are fixed by that ranking (their Table S2 occupancies sum to the printed 23.9% and 41.9%). Places 13 and 14 are a five-way tie at recurrence 2 that the printed table does not resolve; the tie-break above gives 77.6% where Fig. 3F prints 76.9%.

qc.assignment: top-1 nearest normal cell-type centroid by cosine in the nine-dimensional space
qc.calibration: single_cell_scaled (per-cell data); pseudobulk collapses cells onto low-complexity targets

contraction.statement: Most of the raw contraction is shared transcriptional output and the averaging itself; a smaller module-shape convergence remains under two of three scalings.

complexity_control.axis: deciles of detected genes per malignant cell, lowest to highest

dimensionality.note: The magnitude depends on dimensionality; the anchor does not (cytotrophoblast is the top target in six dimensions).

two_d_vs_nine_d.note: Convergence is a high-dimensional nearest-neighbour property, not a 2-D location.

catalog_dependence.statement: The four criteria constrain the region but do not by themselves select the cell inside it: the cytotrophoblast is the anchor under this catalog.

tissue_baselines_pct.note: Normal epithelium occupies the state to a tissue-dependent degree: it is a physiological state, not a cancer-specific destination.

time_resolved.dataset: PC9 lung-adenocarcinoma cells through erlotinib (Aissa 2021, GSE134839)
time_resolved.caveat: Cell line, survivorship thins later timepoints, no lineage tracing: movement of cells cannot be separated from selection.

retracted: Baseline gating of the within-patient increase (present where normal tissue sits low, absent in high-baseline lung). The 'absent in lung' reading was a cell-selection artifact: the Census lung 'tumour' arm was ~9% annotated-malignant cells and ~91% normal-adjacent alveolar epithelium. With cleanly identified malignant cells lung deepens like every other tissue tested (GSE131907: 10 of 10 patients). No baseline-gating claim is made.

The fold-change framing of the within-patient increase (about sixfold). The fold-change is inflated by the small normal denominator; the effect is reported in percentage points (about +10 points, flat against baseline on the additive scale).
The prostate 'saturated high-baseline tissue' justification (it rested on the baseline-gating hypothesis). Prostate is reported as an open negative.

The comparison against random 25-cell-type draws (a Stayton-type test) and the fold-contraction it produced: the null ignored the averaging itself. Superseded by the matched-averaging null (Note S-G).
The structural argument that the two core cells share polyploidy by endoreduplication: the anchor is the mononuclear diploid villous cytotrophoblast.
The reading that malignant occupants run the cGAS-STING module hotter: the module was scored on a three-gene fragment without either sensor (Note S-Q).
The argument that malignant-cell contamination makes the reported numbers a lower bound (tested on HCC and BRCA; not borne out).
limits: Convergence is a static geometric test: a convergent endpoint across origins, not a measured trajectory, and not a proven dynamical attractor.
The convergence region is the robust finding; the cytotrophoblast anchor is conditional on this catalog (independent curations reproduce the region but name the gastric progenitor).
Most of the raw contraction is shared transcriptional output; the module-shape residue is real but modest and specification-dependent.
The corrected gene-symbol catalog (Note S-Q) has not been re-derived end to end; headline numbers use the legacy symbol handling.
A CNV-inference malignant-cell floor across all 25 cohorts is deferred; three cohorts are marker-labelled.
The 154-type gallery is sparse in progenitor and fetal cells; the trophoblast reference comes from a different dataset and platform (Vento-Tormo 2018).
Immune privilege is not inherited (62 colorectal tumours: no association with T/NK infiltration).
Single-gene perturbation does not move the state (Perturb-seq in K562, an unfavourable substrate; combinatorial knockdowns untested).
Pre-invasive prediction holds in colorectum and directionally in breast but fails in esophagus (non-dysplastic Barrett's); dysplasia is untested.
The post-colonization reading (metastasis sits lower) rests on nodal metastases and small numbers.
The within-patient module comparison (Fig. 6) is colorectal only.
